sources.title: White House Weighs Folding FDIC Into Other Agencies
OCC combines supervision into single unit

status_summary: No bill or order merging these regulators was found. A report dated 2025-02-12, citing the Wall Street Journal, described the White House as weighing folding the FDIC into Treasury or combining its supervisory role with the OCC, without any decision. The OCC announced on 2025-04-16 that it would combine its large, midsize and community bank supervision units into one division effective 2025-06-02, which is an internal reorganization, not a merger of agencies.
title: Merge the bank and credit union regulators into one supervisor
uncertainties: No bill, order or law merging the OCC, FDIC, NCUA and the Board's supervisory functions was found. A 2025-02-12 report of White House deliberation on the FDIC is not an event, and the OCC's 2025 internal combination of supervision units is not an agency merger. The FDIC and OCC newsrooms could not be read. The Unified Agenda rule lists on reginfo.gov for Treasury (including the OCC), the FDIC, the NCUA and the Federal Reserve (all headed 'Agency Rule List - 2026') list no supervisor consolidation; merger entries such as 1557-AF29 and 3133-AG01 to AG03 concern bank and credit union mergers. A merger needs legislation, so the agenda is a weak test. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
